name: Gum Slough spring run (paddle-in only)
area: Withlacoochee River at the Sumter/Marion line; launch at Inverness, Citrus County
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationDestination: Turner Camp Road Public Boat Ramp, 9460 E Turner Camp Rd, Inverness, FL 34453
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Launch at the Turner Camp Road ramp, paddle about 20 minutes on the Withlacoochee to the slough mouth, then work upstream through a winding canopied maze to the upper springs about four miles up. Low river levels make it very shallow, and the route is confusing, so carry a GPS track.
cost: Ramp listed as free by Citrus County directories (one directory shows a $5 fee; confirm on site)
access: Paddle-in only; the only public access is by boat from the Withlacoochee River. No restrooms at the ramp. Own or rented boat required (no outfitter verified here).

conditions.summary: No 2026 closure or restriction found for Gum Slough. name: Upper Hillsborough Tract primitive campground (Southwest Florida Water Management District)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: A bare primitive campground in pine flatwoods on a 6,978-acre tract along the upper Hillsborough River; the district says 'No amenities available' apart from a portable toilet. The main entrance is on CR 54 about three miles east of Zephyrhills. The map point is OpenStreetMap's match for CR 54 near that entrance, so navigate by the address.
